description: Export Dendro analysis in one of four formats: "mermaid" (flowchart syntax for docs), "json" (enriched multi-analysis document), "svg" (color-coded diagram image), "markdown" (formatted report — supports persona: developer/ceo/investor/eng-manager/onboarding). Format-specific options are ignored by other formats.

analyses.description: json/markdown: which analyses to include. Default: ["tree"] (markdown default depends on persona)

entryFile.description: Absolute path to the entry React component file

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth for tree traversal. Default: unlimited

persona.description: markdown: target audience — changes formatting, language, structure. Default: developer

name: export_analysis
